posts.title: Samsung 980 Pro died, critical warning 0x09: How I cloned a dying NVMe SSD
posts.description: On Monday afternoon all of a sudden my self-hosted server died. I couldn’t access it. My paranoid ass thought it was hackers. I was traumatised with keyloggers and viruses when I was a kid, so these things really freak me out. However, it turned out that the machine died. Phew?

posts.title: Becoming dad
posts.description: Austrian girl and her grandparents I knew I wanted to be a parent and have kids when I was in middle school. Back then I thought that life is quite amazing.
